title: Refund Policy
content: Customers can request a refund for eligible orders within the applicable refund window. Refund eligibility must be checked using the order details and the ticket creation date.

title: Shipping Policy
content: Customers can request assistance for delayed shipments. Carrier investigation may be initiated when shipment tracking indicates a delivery problem.

title: Warranty Policy
content: Warranty claims are available for eligible products subject to the applicable warranty period and product category.
